landing.heroSub: A simple family app that keeps everyone on the same page. The colour ring tells you at a glance — and alerts the whole family when it turns red.
landing.noAppStore: No app store needed. Works on any phone or computer.
landing.step1Desc: Create a profile with their name and photo. Set how often they should be visited — the ring starts counting.
landing.step2Desc: Share a link or code. Everyone joins the same profile. No accounts needed for family members — just tap and join.
landing.step3Desc: After each visit, tap 'Log a Visit'. The ring resets to green. If it turns red, the family gets a nudge — privately, not publicly.
landing.feat1Desc: Green to red — see instantly how long it's been
landing.feat2Desc: Everyone gets notified when Gran needs a visit
landing.feat3Desc: Claim a date so the family knows it's covered
landing.feat4Desc: Invite the whole family with a single link
landing.priceLine: One subscription covers the whole family.
landing.billedAppStore: Billed through the App Store in your local currency.
landing.noCard: No credit card needed. Free forever for one gran profile.
landing.footMade: © 2026 GranWatch — made with love, for every gran.
landing.getAppSub: The app adds push alerts and the home-screen widget — or just continue in your browser.
